title: To The End
description: You hear whispered tales that a stronghold is not the only way to the end...
body:
Friends, Romans, Countrymen and all! Lend me your sense of adventure for a minute. 


This mod arose out of the need to construct more end portals for when your players destroy them all. However, the need is great, and you will need lots of rare materials to craft it. You will need to persevere to complete the challenge. To aid you in your task, it is highly reccomended to use a mod such as [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) to show you the process.

**To do:**
- Emerald SMP wiki
- Custom mobs
- Custom biomes
- Instruction video

This mod was built for the 2026 Emerald SMP, however you can still use this in your modpack as long as you reference where it came from.

This mod was made possible by [Mcreator](https://mcreator.net/)
